subject: "Unexpected response from server" when uploading files > a few mb

messages.author: 5309b0c46f61c126
messages.subject: "Unexpected response from server" when uploading files > a few mb
parts:
Hi all,

I hope it's OK to ask this question in this group.

I've installed RStudio in an instance in the Google Cloud, and it works well, with one big exception. When I try to upload a file to the program from my laptop, it only works if the files are very small. The filetype is csv or txt. 

I don't think the issue is with the content of these files, because they work fine when I use RStudio on my laptop, and because I'm able to upload files to the cloud-RStudio when I copy some of the text to a smaller spreadsheet file, e.g. a mini-version of the dataset. 

Could it be a firewall that prevents "large" files from being uploaded to the program?

I've discussed the issue at the bottom of this page.

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: "Unexpected response from server" when uploading files > a few mb
parts:
Hi there,

This actually isn't the right forum--this forum talks about Shiny, which is a web framework that you can use to upload files too, but it's not what you want in this case. You're talking about the RStudio IDE Server, which has its own upload functionality. I'd head over to http://support.rstudio.com and start a thread there, they should be able to help you out.

Sorry I gave you the wrong link to the support forum.  But following on from the comments section, you should be uploading .zip files if you can - you zip a folder of multiple files (or perhaps your big file) and choose Upload to use it.  If that doesn't work though, do use the link Joe provided below to lodge a ticket, I'm keeping tabs on it out of interest to see what the solution is.
Yours sincerely,
